chapter.verse: Misiangthote’ vakna thu note kiangah kong gelh hangin na phattuamna uh om tuam lo ding hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in huh nopna lungsim na neih uh ka thei hi. Tua huh nopna lungsim hangin ka kisathei hi. “Akhaia gam mite in nikum pekin a khol zo uh hi,” ci-in Makedonia gam mite kiangah ka gen thei hi. Note’ thanopna lungsim in mi tampi a hansuah zo hi.
Ahih hangin note hanga kote’ kisaktheihna in a mawkna suak loin, tua kam mah bangin a kigingkholsa-in na om nading uh ka u ka naute kong sawl hi.

Tua bang a hih kei leh, Makedonia mi kimkhat in kei tawh hong pai khawmin note a kholsa-a na om loh uh hong mu le-uh note’ zum ding gen loh, lau lo-a kong muan’na sa uhah kote in ka maizum ding uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nidang a, kiciamsa note’ sumpi piakna, zawhthawh thu-a piak sum bang hi loin, hehpihna bangin khol kholh nadingin ka u ka naute in no kiangah hong pai masa-in, tua sumpi na kiginkholh nadingun hong hansuah loin om leng, kilawm ka sa kei hi.
Khaici tawmkha a vawhte in tawmkha a at ding hi, citpiakna tawh a tampi a vawhte in a tampi a at ding hi ci-in na ciamteh un.

Mi khempeuh in amau lungsim sung uhah a hanciam bangin pia uh hen. Hazatna lungsim tawh ahi zongin, khia loin om thei lo ding cihna lungsim tawh ahi zongin kipia lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, piak nopna lungsim tawh a pia mi bek Pasian in a it hi.
Note in na khempeuhah na zat khop ding uh sum a pawlpawl na neih niloh uh a, gamtatpha apawlpawl tawh na dim mahmah nadingun thupha apawlpawl a kicin’ nading Pasian in a hih thei hi.
Lai Siangtho in: “Amah in a hawmthang zo hi, mi zawngte a thupha a hawm zo hi; Ama dikna in a kip tawntung hi,” a ci hi.
Khaici vawhte’ khaici ahi zongin, nek theih an ahi zongin a piapa in note vawh ding khaici hong pia a, a khangsak ding a, note dikna’ gahte a tamsak ding hi.
Tua bangin note in hehpihna lungsim tawh apawl apawl hawmsak a, na piak nadingun na khempeuh na hauh uh ciangin kote tungah Pasian’ hehpihna phatna ding a om ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hih nasepna in Pasian’ mite lak-a, mizawngte zawn’na a huh tham loin, Pasian’ hehpihna phat nadingin na tampi tawh a dim hi.

Note in Khazih’ Lungdamna Thu deihna-ah a kilanga na zuih uh ahi zongin, tua misiangthote-a kipan mi khempeuh hehpihna lungsim tawh hawmin na piakna uh ahi zongin, amau in a ngaihsut uh ciangin tua kivakna lim teci paulamin Pasian’ hehpihna a phat thei uh hi.
Note tungah a lamdang Pasian’ hehpihna thupha amaute in ngaihsunin, note ading thungenin, note hong lunggulh uh hi.
A kigen khin zo lo hong piakkhong letsong thupha hangin Pasian tungah hehpihna phatna om ta hen!
